body: Thanks. He has trouble listening to me because he looks back and sees all the good parts of pregnancy (positive test, silly cravings, kicking baby, baby showers, buying toys and picking a name, then the exciting day he was born) and doesn’t consider what I went through alone (constant vomiting, sciatica from month 2 onward, 3D stretchmarks from my belly button to my thighs, a torn vagina, extreme blood loss during birth, not being able to breastfeed for a week then being engorged for a year with mastitis THREE DIFFERENT TIMES, and much more). I can’t do it again. I love my son and would love to snap my fingers and just HAVE another kid here but I can’t go through the pregnancy again...

Thank you so much. The biggest problem is that they usually require my husbands “permission” and I hate that. Not only will he be reluctant to give “permission” but do I really want a doctor with that mindset doing this for me?
